bundle.shortDescription: Capture, annotate, and ask AI about anything on your screen
bundle.longDescription: Shotvera is a fast, cross-platform screenshot tool. Select a region or window, mark it up with arrows, shapes, text, steps and blur, then copy, save or pin it. A built-in Claude assistant explains what is on screen, extracts and translates text, redacts sensitive details and draws annotations for you.
